scope: Fixed native final outputs; provisional single-token display only. Final WER unchanged by construction.
timing: Paired stable-word display gain on exactly reference-matched final words; simulated native arrivals plus measured additional CPU forecaster time, including state updates and speculative decoding. No independent phonetic timestamps, actual UI or live encoder resource contention measured.
uncertainty: 1000 paired utterance and speaker-cluster bootstrap replicates. Model seeds 37/38 for full state model; ablations seed37. These intervals do not estimate training-seed variance.
memory: Live tensor byte counts for bounded new forecaster states; excludes backbone, weights, allocator/temporary activations and offline evaluation cache. No claim of bounded whole-system memory.
risk: Thresholds meet 0.5 false introduced forecasts/100 native tokens on dev calibration only. Test rates may differ; compare gain AND actual test error rates.
